html:
📍 Location: Connecticut, USA

🧪 Industry: Financial Services

⏳ Timeframe: 12 Months

From Challenges to Consistency: Paypro Corp’s Lead Generation Success with MarketJoy

“MarketJoy has been a key partner for our lead generation efforts and always goes above and beyond. As our needs have shifted, they’ve been flexible and adaptable to help us generate ROI.”

– Eric Wagner, Head of Marketing, Paypro Corp

About PayPro Corp:

PayPro Corp provides cloud-based workforce management solutions designed for businesses of all sizes, including large enterprise organizations and Fortune 500 companies. Their HR technology helps companies manage the full employee lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding to performance tracking and retirement.

The Challenge: Inconsistent Lead Flow and a Crowded Market

Before partnering with MarketJoy, PayPro relied mainly on referrals to bring in new business. While referrals generated opportunities, the flow was inconsistent and made it difficult to maintain a predictable sales pipeline.

At the same time, competing in a crowded financial and HR services market created another hurdle. Standing out from other providers and reaching new prospects was becoming more difficult. Without a clear outbound strategy, connecting with HR leaders and generating steady growth remained a challenge.

Campaign Goal: Boost Outbound Lead Flow

PayPro wanted to build a more reliable outbound lead generation engine. The main objective was to secure qualified meetings and product demos with HR directors, HR managers, and other key decision-makers.

The Strategy:

📞 Discovery and Planning: MarketJoy began with a detailed onboarding process to understand PayPro’s business, ideal customer profile, and growth goals. This helped identify the best-fit prospects and refine messaging for stronger outreach.

👨‍💻 Market-Focused Positioning: As remote and hybrid work models continued to grow, outreach messaging highlighted how PayPro could help businesses manage distributed teams more efficiently.

📧 Targeted Email Outreach: A multi-step email campaign was launched to engage qualified prospects across target markets. Performance was reviewed regularly, allowing campaigns to be adjusted and improved based on response rates and engagement.

The result?

MarketJoy delivered outstanding results:

  • 152 high-quality leads in just 10 months (15 leads per month on average).
  • Paypro upgraded to MarketJoy’s Yearly program, gaining access to enhanced services like LinkedIn outreach and priority support.
  • The integration of MarketJoy’s AI platforms promises to elevate lead generation outcomes even further.

Ready to transform your lead generation strategy?
